profile.summary: Operations and process improvement leader with 20+ years of experience building and scaling businesses from the ground up. Founded and grew a corporate housing services company to $4.5M in revenue without external capital, demonstrating exceptional entrepreneurial execution and operational discipline. Specialized in transforming subjective, opinion-driven management into data-driven decision-making frameworks; excels at designing and deploying scalable processes, cost optimization, and procurement strategy. Proven ability to diagnose organizational inefficiencies, architect solutions, and drive measurable financial impact—including 14% operational cost reductions and 11% COGS improvements. Strong negotiator with deep expertise in strategic business analysis, team development, and navigating volatile market conditions.
